title: 通胀不降就加息：美联储的务实纪律，市场为何反而叫好？
speaker: Ben Bennett

segments.en: Yeah, I think he was surprisingly pragmatic, you know, saying that actually we do want to focus on inflation, and that's the key for us.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为他出人意料地务实，他说我们确实要关注通胀，这对我们来说很关键。

segments.en: So if inflation doesn't come down, we have to hike interest rates. I think it was really good because from an investor perspective, you want to have the clarity that they have that reaction function.
segments.zh: 所以如果通胀不下降，我们就必须加息。我认为这很好，因为从市场参与者角度看，你希望明确他们的应对机制。

segments.en: But you don't want to have the clarity that they're just going to keep interest rates low forever, because then bad things happen. Investments get made that shouldn't get made because interest rates are too low, you put on too much leverage.
segments.zh: 但你不希望明确他们永远维持低利率，因为那样会出问题。利率过低会导致不该发生的配置发生，杠杆也会过高。

segments.en: I actually quite like this discipline, this pragmatic discipline, I've called it. So yeah, I think it was a really, really good speech, and I would say long term, this is also good for the treasury market, and good for the US growth perspective.
segments.zh: 我其实很喜欢这种纪律，我称之为务实纪律。所以我认为这是一次非常好的讲话，长期看对国债市场和美国增长前景也是好事。
